0: City of White 29 W Rocky Street White, GA 30184 Dear Valued Trash Customer: We are pleased to announce that as of February 2026, Mauldin Trash Services will be our new vendor for trash services. On Jan 28th, the City of White will make its last trash run and at this time you will get your new trash can(s). We are also proud to announce a decrease in the costs of trash service: (1) Inside city - $14 (2) Seniors - $12 (3) Outside city - $17 (4) Extra can - $9 Now, Mauldin is not charging you a deposit on your trash can, so if you have a trash can deposit on your account it will be credited to your account during the February billing. Your trash day will remain the same. Mauldin will leave your new can in the spot they want you to leave it in order to receive service. If you have any questions, please give us a call. After Jan 28th, all trash related issues will be discussed with Mauldin Trash Services 706-337-2603. Their number will be one of the options when you call city hall. Regards, Curtis Powell Mayor, City of White
